abbreviations.definition: A double-blind study is one in which neither the participant nor any of the investigator or sponsor staff who are involved in the treatment or clinical evaluation of the subjects are aware of the treatment received.

A complaint is any written, electronic, or oral communication that alleges deficiencies related to the identity, quality, purity, durability, reliability, safety or effectiveness, or performance of a drug or drug delivery system.
Adherence to all study-related, good clinical practice, and applicable regulatory requirements.

A data monitoring committee is a group of independent scientists who are appointed to monitor the safety and scientific integrity of a human research intervention, and to make recommendations to the sponsor regarding the stopping of a study for efficacy, or for harms, or for futility. The composition of the committee is dependent upon the scientific skills and knowledge required for monitoring the particular study.
The act of assigning a participant to a treatment. Participants who are enrolled in the study are those who have been assigned to a treatment.

A process by which a participant voluntarily confirms his or her willingness to participate in a particular study, after having been informed of all aspects of the study that are relevant to the participant’s decision to participate. Informed consent is documented by means of a written, signed and dated informed consent form.
An interim analysis is an analysis of clinical study data, separated into treatment groups, that is conducted before the final reporting database is created/locked.

A pharmaceutical form of an active ingredient or placebo being tested or used as a reference in a clinical trial, including products already on the market when used or assembled (formulated or packaged) in a way different from the authorized form, or marketed products used for an unauthorized indication, or marketed products used to gain further information about the authorized form.
Equivalent to CDISC term “subject”: An individual who participates in a clinical trial, either as recipient of an investigational medicinal product or as a control.
The act of determining if an individual meets minimum requirements to become part of a pool of potential candidates for participation in a clinical study.

Treatment-emergent adverse event: An untoward medical occurrence that emerges during a defined treatment period, having been absent pretreatment, or worsens relative to the pretreatment state, and does not necessarily have to have a causal relationship with this treatment.

notes: SUB-STUDY OF A MASTER PROTOCOL. Page 1 reads verbatim: "This study H0P-MC-NP02 (NCT05177094) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". This document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-NP02 for LY3526318 to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP; only this document was used, nothing was filled from the master protocol or the DPNP disease-state addendum (DSA) CPMP(3). What this document defers to the master protocol / DSA: the SoA itself (p11: the ISA SoA shows only visits and procedures unique to the ISA; 'Please refer to the CPMP Master Protocol and the DPNP DSA CPMP(3) SoAs for additional information'); clinical laboratory tests (p29, Appendix 1: 'The CPMP Master Protocol describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA' - the ISA table lists only 'Other Tests': LY3526318 concentration and Urine pregnancy). So the composition, specimen and lab of the SoA activities Hematology, Chemistry, Lipid panel, Urinalysis, Urine drug screen and HbA1c are not given in this document (deferred to the master protocol); no panels for them are recorded. Also deferred: objectives and endpoints (p8, p18), eligibility (p21), preparation/handling/storage (p22), concomitant therapy (p23), discontinuation (p24), adverse events (p25), statistical considerations (p27). Instruments: the SoA section 'Scales, Questionnaires, and Outcome Measures' (p11) is covered by a 'CCI' redaction box, so no SoA instrument rows are readable; the only instrument named in the text is the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) diary (p19, Section 4.1). The text does not link the NRS to a named SoA activity, so its soa_activities is empty. The NRS abbreviation is defined differently in two places: 'Numeric Rating Scale' (Appendix 5 p41, and the p18 abbreviation line) vs 'numerical rating scale' (SoA abbreviation line p12); both are recorded. The first entry of the SoA abbreviation line (p12) is redacted ('CCI'). The SoA Notes cell of 'Participant returns device' is redacted (p12); the text does not say what the device is. Pregnancy testing: Appendix 2 (p31) gives the general condition 'Negative urine result at screening followed by a negative serum result within 24 hours prior to treatment exposure. Note: Subsequent pregnancy testing is compound specific.'; the ISA SoA and Appendix 1 list only Urine pregnancy - both recorded in lab_and_purpose evidence, not resolved. Lab (central/local): the only statement is the exceptional-circumstances option on p38 ('Local laboratory testing may be conducted in lieu of central laboratory testing'), which names no SoA activity, so lab is null throughout. SoA rows the text does not describe: Hematology, Chemistry, Lipid panel, Urinalysis, HbA1c (deferred to master), Scales, Questionnaires, and Outcome Measures (redacted), Participant returns device (redacted note). Intervention compliance is described on p22 (Section 6.4: direct questioning and counting returned capsules) but is not a lab, instrument or measurement. Tokens in SoA activity names: ECG, PK and HbA1c are all defined (HbA1c only in the SoA abbreviation line p12, not in Appendix 5). Rule 10: the text layer of many pages is letter-spaced (e.g. 'P h ysical e xa mi nati o n'); evidence quotes, what_it_says, target headings and the SoA-page abbreviations (p12) are copied from it as is, while field values (components, analytes, names, conditions) are given in their printed un-spaced form, each verified to occur on its page. Pages 11, 12 (SoA) and 29 (Appendix 1 lab table) were checked on the page image; the Appendix 1 table has a single column 'Other Tests' with two rows, consistent with the text layer, followed by a redaction box. No page lacks a text layer. Rule 11: the PDF holds one version only - Protocol H0P-MC-NP02(a), Amendment [a], approval date 30-Sep-2021 (original protocol 04-Jun-2021 appears only in the document history, p4); the SoA (pp11-12) is from this version. Many pages carry 'CCI' redaction boxes. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind; letter-spaced abbreviation terms and definitions re-spaced (whitespace only, checked from page images).
